sources.title: Gemma Model Family - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: The family has two halves. A mainline generation — Gemma 1 through Gemma 4 — is the general purpose model most people want. Around each generation sits a set of variants: the same architecture retrained or restructured for one job, like embeddings, safety classification or vision-language tasks.

sources.title: atlas-institute/gemma26b-offsec-coder-gguf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The SFT foundation uses the V10 mixed dataset with unified Nexus system prompt injection across all ~47K examples. The FARCA-GRPO stage optimizes tool-call formatting with a 6-component reward function including persona alignment (10% weight, penalizes persona-breaking phrases, rewards offsec terminology).
